# Security

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem. Report it privately through
[GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/mmrmagno/jellyfin-plugin-streamfin/security/advisories/new)
instead, and I will get back to you as soon as I can.

Only the latest release gets fixes. Updates reach every server through the plugin
repository, so a fix is out as soon as it is released.
